name: Sudou Mizuki
source:
The young lady of the prestigious conglomerate, the Sudo Group. Because she used to live in France, a characteristic of hers is that snippets of French blend into her speech here and there. She believes herself to be the étoile (star) of Habataki Academy. She also has a bit of a selfish side, and it seems she has few friends.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.tokimemo-type.com/tkmkgstype/character/index.html]official website[/url]]
